messages:
carmen-oncall: quick heads-up: noticed ~0.6% TLS handshake failures for eu-west->us-east right after the 09:00 deploy. opening thread for owners.

emily-sre: thanks. can you paste one sample log line?

carmen-oncall: snippet in incident doc: `tls: handshake timeout; route=eu-west->us-east; retries=3`.

vijay-net: looking at LB egress logs  see SYN retransmits and small MSS in SYN-ACK from a subset of gateways between 09:05-09:15. likely PMTU-related.

tom-platform: note the deploy toggled session-stickiness to reduce fanout; might have concentrated traffic on the bad path.

emily-sre: action: vijay to capture pcap + run traceroute/tcp replay and upload to s3. owner=vijay-net, due=EOD Thu.

vijay-net: ack. plan to test `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` on a staging gateway to validate.

inc-bot: INC-7017 created: "cross-region TLS handshake increase" assigned to vijay-net, emily-sre.

kate-pm: we should add a deploy gate: if handshake_fail_rate >0.5% for 10m, auto-rollback. owner=tom-platform, ETA=48h.

tom-platform: will add alert + rollback playbook and link runbook here when done.

emily-sre: also adding per-route handshake failure metric to Console (owner=emily-sre, PR by next Tue). recurring check-ins weekly x3.

carmen-oncall: summary: 1) vijay - pcap + staging test (EOD Thu). 2) tom - alert + rollback automation (48h). 3) emily - per-route metric PR (next Tue) + weekly cadence. will close after 24h prod stable.

vijay-net: staging test shows mtu_probing fixes handshake rate on synthetic (99.2%->99.99%). uploading pcap: s3://redwood-logs/pcaps/1935000000-mtu.pcap

tom-platform: alert/playbook wired, runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/egress-tls-failures

carmen-oncall: thanks everyone. keeping thread open for 24h post-prod-stable to collect any regressions.
